No token, hook, pool, ETH funding or initialization call belongs to this manifest; the deployer binds the separately launched hook later, and the hook must name this organism and a fixed-supply exact-transfer PLANT token. Ended days through the bind day settle empty in one bounded call; the first heartbeat requests the first full UTC day after bind once that day ends. One stake rule: stake[cell] is PLANT parked behind the cell since the previous successful settle; mid-day parks count from the next settle and unparked amounts drop out at once. The move at settle, challenger nomination, the 5% threshold and the gardener pool all use it, never live balances, so a flash park and unpark can neither move the plant nor earn rewards. Relocation needs strictly more retained stake than the current cell and at least ceilDiv(PLANT.totalSupply() - burned, 20). A request cleared as unanswered after 24 hours counts as a strike like an incomplete result; retries wait 6 hours and the third strike settles that day empty with a relocation READ. heartbeat(maxAdvance) reverts before pulling a caller fee advance above maxAdvance. rotate carries a deadline inside the signed Rotate struct; block.timestamp greater than deadline reverts. Each previous signer keeps 30 days of attestation grace only. Hours, sips, pot/backing/owed accounting, oracle body and question text are unchanged from the accepted work; the callback stays under 200000 gas and settle under 400000 gas. Death is final. No admin, upgrade, pause, roles, proxy, delegatecall or selfdestruct exists.
